name: Kawata Junko
source:
Home-visit caregiver.
Because her household finances became tight due to fertility treatments, she returned to work as a caregiver, a job she held before marriage. Her only experience with men was with her husband, and she was indifferent to sex, but as she began interacting with the elderly people she cared for, she became increasingly immersed in it.
